description: List DevGlow workspaces: id, name, which one the user is in, and the processes placed in each with their running state. Use it before delete_workspace, and to find workspaces left over from earlier work — one whose processes are all stopped or gone is a likely leftover. It cannot tell you who made a workspace; the user arranges them by hand too.
name: list_workspaces
title: List workspaces
